record.edic_text:
5394 phlogizo {flog-id'-zo}

from 5395;; v

AV - set on fire 2; 2

1) to ignite, set on fire
2) to burn up
3) fig. to operate destructively, have a most pernicious power
   3a) of that in which the destructive influences are kindled
